document_review.authorship_disclosure: Final2 reviewer made no production changes; performed read-only document and export-precision evidence review.
document_review.scope: Read-only final2 source/diff and documentation accuracy review. Examined the export-only coordinate-origin correction, unchanged surface checker, meaningful regression coverage, README and BD rail/mount rationale. Reuses prior geometry/document evidence only where relevant source hashes remain identical. This is not a result of the pending final2 full native suite, pipeline, STEP exports or visual inspection; no source files were edited and no expensive CAD checks were rerun.

pipeline_pass_scope: Final2 build, preview, compare, validate and bundle all completed in order with exit0 on the frozen source. No inferred or recovered stage completion is accepted.

historical_first_attempt.scope: Initial interrupted orchestration, subsequently identified STL failure and attempted recovery are retained only as history.

export_origin_correction.scope: Export-only XY translation with Z seated at zero; native geometry fixture unchanged.
export_origin_correction.final_acceptance: Current full native suite and strict ordered final2 pipeline, including saved STL and STEP checks.

visual_review.scope: Manual visual inspection of current saved-source previews: complete assembly, retained propulsion, export layout, direct optional power, both optical hosts, attachment coupon and revised nine-station rail. Geometry/access findings are supported by separate native checks, not inferred from views alone.
findings: No unexpected displaced/missing assembly components or preview clipping.
Rail preserves all earlier wing stations and adds symmetric near-battery wings.
Common square plates and both optical hosts remain visually consistent; direct tether packaging preserved.
Print preview shows unique export shapes including coupons; quantities come from the manifest, not image counts.
XY-centred export parts preserve the positive separated overview layout; no visual overlap introduced.

blender.scope: All exported integer-frame native samples, exact CAD-part inventories and visibility, and scene object/action isolation. CAD millimetres become metres with a global X half-turn. Quaternion sign continuity is checked between samples. No continuous-time interpolation, collision, physics, or source-CAD freshness certification is claimed.

limits: Nominal rigid CAD checks only. Physical curved-rail fit/bend radius, flatness/creep, servo radial capacity, horn runout, bearing shield clearance, fasteners, adhesive/insulation, wire/tether routing, heat, FC input compatibility and flight qualification remain unresolved.
